+package server_test
+
+import (
+	"bytes"

+	"errors"

+	"net/http"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+

+
+// newStore opens the SQLite store of a test, closed when the test ends.
+func newStore(t *testing.T) store.Store {
+	t.Helper()
+	st, err := store.Open(t.TempDir())
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("open store: %v", err)
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = st.Close() })
+	return st
+}
+
+// login creates the user and a session for them, and returns a request
+// builder that carries the session cookie on every call to url+path.
+func login(t *testing.T, st store.Store, name string) func(method, path string, body any) *http.Request {
+	t.Helper()
+	user, err := st.GetUserByUsername(name)
+	if errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
+		user, err = st.CreateUser(name, "hash")
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("user %s: %v", name, err)
+	}
+	token, err := store.NewToken(22)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := st.CreateSession(user.ID, token, time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Hour)); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("session for %s: %v", name, err)
+	}
+	return func(method, path string, body any) *http.Request {
+		var r io.Reader
+		if body != nil {
+			data, err := json.Marshal(body)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("marshal %v: %v", body, err)
+			}
+			r = bytes.NewReader(data)
+		}
+		req, err := http.NewRequest(method, path, r)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if body != nil {
+			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+		}
+		req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: token})
+		return req
+	}
+}
+
+// do sends a request and reads the whole answer.
+func do(t *testing.T, req *http.Request) (int, []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("%s %s: %v", req.Method, req.URL.Path, err)
+	}
+	defer func() { _ = res.Body.Close() }()
+	body, err := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("read the body of %s %s: %v", req.Method, req.URL.Path, err)
+	}
+	return res.StatusCode, body
+}
+
+// note is a note as the API answers it.
+type note struct {
+	ID        int64    `json:"id"`
+	Title     string   `json:"title"`
+	Body      string   `json:"body"`
+	Tags      []string `json:"tags"`
+	Pinned    bool     `json:"pinned"`
+	CreatedAt string   `json:"created_at"`
+	UpdatedAt string   `json:"updated_at"`
+}
+
+func decodeNote(t *testing.T, body []byte) note {
+	t.Helper()
+	n := note{}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &n); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("the answer is no note JSON: %q: %v", body, err)
+	}
+	return n
+}
+
+func equalStrings(a, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range a {
+		if a[i] != b[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}

+	}

+	}
+	return func(method, path string, body any) *http.Request {
